notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
The Saprolings enter the battlefield as Forest lands due to Life and Limb, triggering Evolution Sage twice.
Resolve both Evolution Sage triggers, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.
